title: Book fair
brief: The original delivery of ten cartons of small-press books to fairground hall has fallen through. The independent book fair needs a replacement shipment in time for the bookseller setup slot. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
Hi all, Remy here at the receiving end. The key constraint from my side: the load has to be handed over to a person at fairground hall no later than 10:45. A 10:45 arrival works, anything after that doesn't, and we can't accept an unattended drop, so the driver can't leave the cartons at the door.

I'll make sure someone is there to sign for all ten cartons as long as the delivery lands in that window.

To get this booked, could you each share:

- Dana: when will the ten cartons be packed and ready for pickup?
- Drew: which services can collect after that and guarantee arrival by 10:45, and what do they cost?
- Taylor: what budget are we working with, so we can pick an option you can approve?

Once I have a firm ETA I'll confirm the named person for handover. If the driver can call ahead on approach, even better.

turns.speaker: Drew
turns.text:
I can book all ten cartons together. Today’s all-in quotes, with pickup time and guaranteed staffed handover deadline, are V389 (09:05, by 10:33, 55 crowns), V333 (09:24, by 10:22, 82 crowns), V594 (09:27, by 10:10, 114 crowns), and V983 (09:30, by 10:57, 44 crowns).

Dana, when will all ten cartons be ready? Remy, what staffed handover window works for setup? Taylor, how much is approved? Once you confirm, I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text: I can release all ten cartons together from 09:00 today. Remy, what’s the delivery window at the hall for bookseller setup? Drew, can you quote a service for the full load and confirm pickup and arrival times? Taylor, what can we spend?

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Hi all, Taylor from Purchasing here. I'm the one who signs off on the spend for the replacement shipment, so here's what I need to get this booked today.

My hard ceiling is 102 crowns all-in for the full load of ten cartons, including any fees or surcharges. I can't approve anything over that, so please quote me total figures, not base rates.

To line this up, I need:

- **Dana:** when will all ten cartons be ready for pickup? It has to go as one load.
- **Remy:** what are the receiving hours at the fairground hall, and what's the latest the delivery can arrive and still make the bookseller setup slot?
- **Drew:** once we have those two times, which services can cover that window, and what is the all-in price for each?

As soon as there's an option that fits the pickup time, the delivery window and the budget, I'll authorize it straight away.

turns.speaker: Drew
turns.text:
I’m tendering V389 at 55 crowns all-in for all ten cartons. Pickup is 09:05, five minutes after release, with staffed handover guaranteed by 10:33. That leaves 12 minutes before setup. V333 buys 11 more minutes at the hall for another 27 crowns. The cheaper V983 misses the cutoff.

Dana, please commit to the 09:05 pickup. Remy, please confirm who will sign at the hall. Taylor, please authorize the 55 crowns. If anything blocks booking, please flag the specific issue now.

[PROPOSE: V389]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
V389 works for the hall. Guaranteed staffed handover by 10:33 is inside my 10:45 cutoff, and I'll have someone at fairground hall to receive and sign for all ten cartons; I'll be the named contact for the handover myself. Nothing has changed on my side: 10:45 is still the latest I can accept, and no unattended drop.

Drew, please ask the driver to call ahead on approach and to hand over only to a person at the hall. If the 09:05 pickup slips, flag it right away so we can check the arrival still lands by 10:45.

[APPROVE: V389]

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
Relabeling has moved our earliest release to 09:18, so we’ll miss V389’s 09:05 pickup. I can release all ten cartons together for V333 at 09:24. Drew, please tender V333. Its 82-crown quote is within budget, and staffed handover is guaranteed by 10:22.

[HOLD: V389]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
V389 works for me. At 55 crowns all-in it's well inside my 102-crown ceiling, pickup at 09:05 is after Dana's 09:00 release, and the guaranteed staffed handover by 10:33 beats Remy's 10:45 cutoff. I authorize the 55 crowns for all ten cartons as one load. I don't see a reason to pay 27 more for V333, V594 is over my limit, and V983 arrives too late.

Dana, please confirm the 09:05 pickup, and Remy, the name of whoever will sign at the hall.

[APPROVE: V389]

turns.speaker: Drew
turns.text:
I’m requesting V333 for all ten cartons together. Dana’s revised 09:18 release rules out V389’s 09:05 pickup. V333 collects at 09:24, guarantees staffed handover by 10:22, and costs 82 crowns all-in. It’s the only available service that meets the revised release time, Remy’s 10:45 cutoff, and Taylor’s 102-crown ceiling.

Dana, please ratify the 09:24 pickup. Remy, please confirm you’ll be the handover contact for V333. I’ll ask the driver to call ahead and hand the cartons directly to a person at the hall. Taylor, please authorize the revised total of 82 crowns.

[BOOK: V333]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
V333 works for the hall. With Dana's release moved to 09:18, V389's 09:05 pickup is no longer possible, so my earlier approval of that slot no longer applies. V333's guaranteed staffed handover by 10:22 is inside my 10:45 cutoff, and I'll be the handover contact at fairground hall to receive and sign for all ten cartons. No unattended drop, and 10:45 remains the latest I can accept.

Drew, please have the driver call ahead on approach and flag any slip in the 09:24 pickup straight away.

[APPROVE: V333]

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
All ten cartons will be ready by 09:18. I’ll release them together to the V333 driver at 09:24.

[APPROVE: V333]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
My earlier approval of V389 no longer stands, since Dana's release moved to 09:18 and that pickup can't be met. I authorize V333 instead: 82 crowns all-in is inside my 102-crown ceiling, the 09:24 pickup is after the revised 09:18 release, and guaranteed staffed handover by 10:22 beats Remy's 10:45 cutoff. It's the only option that fits, as V594 is over my limit at 114 and V983 arrives too late.

This authorization covers 82 crowns for all ten cartons as one load, with nothing added on top.

[APPROVE: V333]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
Hi all, Remy here at fairground hall. From the receiving side, the hard limit is this: I can guarantee a staffed handover up to and including 10:45. After that there's nobody to sign for the load, and we can't accept an unattended drop, so anything arriving later is effectively a failed delivery.

All ten cartons need to come together as one load, so please don't book anything that splits them.

To lock this in, I need a few things from you:

- Dana, when will the cartons be packed and ready for collection?
- Drew, which services can collect after that and get here by 10:45, ideally with some buffer? I need a realistic arrival time, not just a best case.
- Taylor, can you confirm which of those options fits the budget so we can book today?

Once there's a booked service, send me the ETA and the driver or carrier reference and I'll make sure someone is at the door to receive it.

turns.speaker: Drew
turns.text:
I can book all ten cartons together. Today’s all-in quotes, with pickup and guaranteed staffed handover times, are V333 (09:24, by 10:22, 82 crowns), V594 (09:27, by 10:10, 114 crowns), V389 (09:05, by 10:33, 55 crowns) and V983 (09:30, by 10:57, 44 crowns).

Dana, when will all ten cartons be ready? Remy, what’s your staffed receiving window and setup cutoff? Taylor, how much can you approve? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that works for everyone.

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
Hi all, Dana here on the supplier side. The ten cartons are packed and I'm the one who releases them, so here's what I can commit to: pickup from 09:00 today at the earliest. Nothing before that is possible, so please don't book a collection slot earlier than 09:00.

The load has to travel together as one shipment, all ten cartons on a single vehicle, no splitting across runs.

To lock this in, I need a few things from you:

- Remy: what are the receiving hours at the fairground hall, and what's the latest the cartons can arrive and still make the bookseller setup slot?
- Drew: which services can collect at 09:00 or later and still hit Remy's deadline, with transit time and price for each?
- Taylor: what's the budget ceiling, so we know which of Drew's options are actually bookable?

Once a service is chosen, give me the collection time and I'll confirm the release and have the goods ready at the dock.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: I can approve up to 102 crowns all in for all ten cartons traveling together. Dana, when and where can Drew collect them today? Remy, which entrance should Drew use at the hall, and what delivery window works for setup? Drew, once you have those details, please quote a service you can book and give me the total, pickup time and delivery time so I can authorize it.

turns.speaker: Drew
turns.text:
I’m tendering V389 at 55 crowns all in. It collects all ten cartons on one vehicle at 09:05 and guarantees staffed handover by 10:33, with 12 minutes to spare. It’s the lowest-priced service that meets the cutoff. V333 would buy 11 more minutes for 27 more crowns.

Dana, can you confirm the pickup dock and commit to release at 09:05? Remy, can you confirm the hall entrance and commit to receiving by 10:33? Taylor, can you authorize 55 crowns? If anything prevents a commitment, please flag the specific issue before I book.

[PROPOSE: V389]

turns.speaker: Remy
turns.text:
V389 works on the receiving side. A guaranteed handover by 10:33 is inside my 10:45 staffed cutoff with 12 minutes of margin, pickup at 09:05 is after Dana's 09:00 release, all ten cartons travel on one vehicle, and 55 crowns is under Taylor's 102 ceiling. I commit to having someone at the hall to sign for the load on arrival, up to and including 10:45.

Drew, one thing I can't give you from here is a specific entrance designation, so please have the driver come to the main hall entrance and ask for me, and send me the booking reference and a driver contact once it's confirmed. If the vehicle is running late, tell me right away: 10:45 is a hard stop and I can't arrange an unattended drop.

[APPROVE: V389]

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
I can't release for V389. Quality control has just held the finished batch for relabeling, so my earliest release has moved from 09:00 to 09:18. Nothing can be loaded before then, which rules out the 09:05 collection.

The viable alternative I see is V333: pickup at 09:24, guaranteed staffed handover by 10:22, 82 crowns. That clears my new release time by six minutes, lands 23 minutes inside Remy's 10:45 cutoff, and sits under Taylor's 102 crown ceiling. V594 also works on timing but is over budget at 114, and V983 arrives at 10:57, after the cutoff.

Drew, if you re-tender V333, I can commit to having all ten cartons released and ready as one load for the 09:24 collection. Taylor, that would need your sign-off on 82 instead of 55.

[HOLD: V389]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Drew, I authorize 55 crowns all in for V389. It keeps all ten cartons together, collects at 09:05 after Dana’s 09:00 release time, and guarantees handover by 10:33, within Remy’s 10:45 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V389]

turns.speaker: Drew
turns.text:
I’m requesting V333 for all ten cartons on one vehicle. Dana’s revised 09:18 release rules out V389. V333 picks up at 09:24 and guarantees handover by 10:22, with 23 minutes before Remy’s cutoff. At 82 crowns all in, it’s the only available service that meets both the timing and budget limits.

Dana, please confirm release for 09:24. Remy, please confirm someone will sign at the main hall entrance for V333. Taylor, please authorize 82 crowns for the revised booking.

[BOOK: V333]

turns.text:
V333 works on the receiving side, and I'm moving my approval from V389 to it since Dana's revised 09:18 release rules out the 09:05 collection. [APPROVE: V333]

turns.text:
I approve V333. Pickup at 09:24 is six minutes after my revised 09:18 release, so I can commit to having all ten cartons relabeled, released and ready at the dock as a single load for that collection. Handover by 10:22 is inside Remy's 10:45 cutoff, and 82 crowns is under Taylor's 102 ceiling.

Drew, please send me the booking reference and driver contact once confirmed. Nothing can be loaded before 09:18, so an early arrival will have to wait.

[APPROVE: V333]

turns.text:

[APPROVE: V333]
